sections.content:
Now I see the issue clearly! There's a NEW frame at rows 32-35, cols 16-19 (node 7, color G with blue center). This is a "trail" frame that was created when the player moved UP. The player is now blocked by this G frame.
Looking at the column 16-19 area:
- Rows 28-31: Frame 2 (charcoal, original target)
- Rows 32-35: New frame (G, created by player movement)
- Row 36: White trail
- Rows 37-39: Player (green)
So the mechanic is: when the player moves, they leave behind a frame. The player can't move through their own trail frames. This explains why the player is stuck - they created a G frame at rows 32-35 by moving UP, and now they can't move further UP.
This changes my understanding of the game significantly. The player creates frames as they move, and these frames need to be converted to white (via SPACE) to clear the path.
So the strategy should be:
1. Press SPACE to convert the G frame (rows 32-35) to white
2. Then move UP again to approach Frame 2
3. Press SPACE to convert Frame 2
Let me try SPACE first to convert the G frame.
